source.raw_prompt: Add a clamp() helper to the fixture strings module that bounds a value between lo and hi inclusive.

objective: Implement clamp(value, lo, hi) in fixture-src/strings.py so it bounds value within [lo, hi] inclusive at both ends.
constraints: No new dependencies without written justification.

acceptance_criteria.description: clamp() returns lo when value is below lo, hi when value is above hi, and value unchanged in between; both boundary cases are covered by tests.

task_graph.description: Research clamp() requirements and existing fixture conventions
